title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1969-02-06
lineage: SBD > MC > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a blistering ’69 show with a scorching Dark Star, Other One > Cryptical, Eleven and Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid sound‑board source that sounds wonderful after the opening few seconds, with only minor “slacking” noted by a couple of reviewers. Musically the concert is hailed as one of the band’s wildest – Dark Star, The Other One > Cryptical, Eleven and Lovelight are repeatedly called out as fire‑breathing highlights, and the overall energy is described as “dripping with goo” and “crazy”.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews (13/16) are 4‑5 stars, praising the performance and noting only minor recording quirks; this consistent enthusiasm yields a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality is praised as wonderful after the first ~5 seconds of the Dew opener; a few reviewers mention slight slacking or minor imperfections, but overall the mix is clear and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe a high‑energy, psychedelic flow that builds after the opening Dew, with the second half especially “dripping with goo” and delivering nonstop intensity.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar tone and on‑stage attitude are repeatedly praised; his banter (“We have some more time…”) is highlighted as a show highlight.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill (Billy) is called “nuts on the drums”; Pigpen’s contribution on Lovelight is noted as blowing the door off.
